spec.sequence: Coming along the track from the west, the line of boards shows first across the water, then the long house standing in the water off the spit near their head and the stage shelter on the islet at their foot.

spec.value: A halt in a sheltered sea cove at the mouth of the pilgrim water, the channel up to Hissmir. Boats off the Padomaic run put in here. The houses stand along the plank walk, which serves as the village street.
It lives on the ferry stage and the toll on boats entering the pilgrim water. It also feeds and lodges the crews.
Thorn's field-owners and the stewards of Hissmir both say the toll on the pilgrim water is theirs.
The only sheltered water on this stretch of coast, under a kilometre from Thorn by the Tear road. Canoes leave the same stage for Hissmir and Murkwater.
Would be bypassed if the cove silted up. The villagers sound the way across the cove to the ferry stage every morning.

A stretch of boards laid at different times, the new planks paler than the old.
